laravel.runtime: Existing tenant-owned executions persistence hardened with canonical bounded job/status/step/error metadata, progress and concurrency state, status/created-time indexes, and site cascade semantics.

acceptance.existing_runtime_only: The adaptation strengthens the existing tenant-owned executions persistence model and does not create a competing execution runtime or queue architecture.
acceptance.canonical_bounds: Job type, status, current step and error/failure detail limits match the source persistence configuration: 80, 40, 300 and 4000 characters.
acceptance.progress_and_concurrency: Progress is constrained to 0..100 and concurrency tokens fail closed when negative; both are persisted as non-negative integer metadata.
acceptance.tenant_scope_isolation: Execution remains a DomainModel using BelongsToTenant, so TenantContext global scoping and cross-tenant create protection remain authoritative and are asserted explicitly by the focused test.
acceptance.site_ownership: The existing site_id foreign key remains required and cascade-on-delete, matching canonical Site ownership semantics without caller-selectable ownership bypass.
acceptance.query_indexes: Status and created_at indexes provide the canonical status/created-time query support.
acceptance.database_portability: SQLite migrate:fresh/full tests and MySQL fresh/rollback/forward/full tests are required on the exact evidence-bearing source SHA.
acceptance.runtime_acceptance: Redis queue/scheduler, WordPress disposable and real REST gates, frontend gates, runtime artifacts, and production-style compose build/boot/runtime smokes are required on the exact evidence-bearing source SHA.

reconciliation_artifacts: Generated by the repository-defined parity pipeline and committed byte-for-byte from its validated output.
